name: Jest of the Dispassionate Island
body:
School: Transmutation; Level: jester 8

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range: Medium (190 ft. + 10 ft./level)

Target: One creature

Duration: 1 round

Saving Throw: none; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

Until the end of your next turn, the target only succeeds on saving throws on a natural roll of 11 or higher.
